name: Name (optional)
passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A few words work well.
registerLead: One account for the browser and iPhone. You can download or delete your data at any time.
twoFactorLead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app or a backup code.
forgotLead: Enter your account email. We will send a link to set a new password.
forgotSent: If an account with this address exists, we sent a link to it. Check your inbox and spam folder.

resetDone: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.
verifyFailed: The link has expired or was already used. Sign in and send a new one from settings.

error_email_taken: An account with this address already exists. Sign in or reset your password.

error_password_too_long: Your password can have at most 256 characters.
error_password_pwned: This password appeared in a data breach elsewhere. Choose another one.
error_terms_required: Accept the terms and the privacy policy.
error_invalid_code: The code is incorrect or has expired.
error_invalid_token: The link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
error_totp_not_pending: Start setting up two-step verification again.
error_google_link_requires_password: An account with this address already exists. Confirm it with the password.
